parsed_json.up: Select activity_id, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as molecule_chembl_id, target_dictionary.chembl_id as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name as target_name, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units. Join activities with molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno, assays on activities.assay_id, and target_dictionary on assays.tid. Filter where target_dictionary.organism is 'Homo sapiens', target_dictionary.target_type is 'SINGLE PROTEIN', standard_units is 'nM', standard_type is in ('EC50', 'IC50', 'AC50'), and standard_value is less than 50. Return distinct rows. Order by activity_id ascending. Limit to 200 rows.
